name: Ear Piercings
overview: Scripture references ear piercings in various contexts, including their use as personal adornment, as seen when Jacob's family surrendered their earrings along with idols (Genesis 35:4) and when Aaron collected golden earrings from the Israelites (Exodus 32:2). Ear piercing also served as a solemn sign of servitude, where a servant's ear was pierced to symbolize lifelong commitment to their master (Exodus 21:6; Deuteronomy 15:17). While these practices are noted, the Lord commands against marking the body for the dead (Leviticus 19:28), distinguishing cultural customs from divine commands.
